# Conduction

> Conduction B.V. is a Dutch open-source software company founded in 2019 in Amsterdam. We build EUPL-1.2 apps for the Nextcloud workspace, used by Dutch municipalities, central government and SMBs. ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified.

Conduction ships ~17 apps that plug into Nextcloud, organised around four product families: Data (registers and catalogs), Processes (case management, decisions, CRM), Connectors (integration platform) and Documents. Every app is open source on GitHub at https://codeberg.org/Conduction, installable from the Nextcloud app store, and has a named product owner.

## Company

- [About Conduction](https://www.conduction.nl/about): who we are, the Digital Socials story, leadership team, named product owners.
- [Apps catalog](https://www.conduction.nl/apps): the full app catalog with status and install counts.
- [Solutions](https://www.conduction.nl/solutions): government use cases (WOO compliance, software catalog, zaakafhandeling, archief, legacy ERP migration, MKB workspace).
- [Partners](https://www.conduction.nl/partners): certified hosting and service partners (Procolix, Acato, Yard and others).
- [ISO certifications](https://www.conduction.nl/iso): ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 scope and audit details.
- [Academy](https://www.conduction.nl/academy): blogs, guides, case studies, webinars, tutorials.

## Apps

- [OpenCatalogi](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/opencatalogi): public software catalog. Every app, dataset, API in your organisation, searchable in one place.
- [OpenRegister](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/openregister): schemas, registers, structured data objects. The typed-data backbone for every Conduction app.
- [Integriq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/openconnector): connect Nextcloud to anything. REST, SOAP, GraphQL, file drops, message queues.
- [Filinq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/docudesk): auto-classify, anonymise, and route inbound documents. Drop them in a folder, get them filed.
- [LaunchPad](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/launchpad): personal and team dashboards built from your registers. No separate BI tool, no extra login.
- [ZaakAfhandelApp](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/zaakafhandelapp): citizen-facing case-status portal. ZGW APIs, archief koppelvlakken, audit trail.
- [Pipelinq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/pipelinq): CRM with quotes, contacts and deal-flow. Built on registers, no separate sales database.
- [Dossiq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/procest): case management for VTH and citizen processes. Workflow engine plus typed registers.
- [Decidiq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/decidesk): decision-support and board management. Agenda, dossiers, motions, voting, audit.
- [Stackiq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/softwarecatalog): IT asset management. Software inventory, licenses, contracts, dependencies.
- [Larpinq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/larpingapp): workflow and process orchestration for live-action role-play events. Visual designer, audit-logged.
- [Learniq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/scholiq): learning record and LMS. Courses, enrolments, certificates, compliance training.
- [Thematiq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/nldesign): drop-in NL Design System theme for Nextcloud, with Conduction component variants on top.
- [Shillinq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/shillinq): business administration on Nextcloud. Invoices, contracts, procurement on shared registers.
- [Buildiq](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/openbuild): citizen-developer app builder. Compose Nextcloud apps from registers, connectors, workflows. No PHP required.
